title: The Mysterious Lightning Beauty
original_title: 江戸川乱歩の美女シリーズ 妖しい稲妻の美女 江戸川乱歩の「魔術師」
overview: A series of mysterious numbers began arriving at the Tamamura family, a family of jewelers. They were terrifying death threats. Kogoro Akechi sets out to investigate, but the culprits strike first and kidnap him, holding him captive. With Akechi in a life-or-death situation, is there any way he can escape the man who calls himself “The Magician”? And why is this magician, possessing the cunning of a devil, targeting the Tamamura family?
